@layer theme, base, components, utilities;

/*
 * @mkbabb/glass-ui — Unified design system styles
 *
 * Import this in your project's main CSS file:
 *   @import "tailwindcss";
 *   @import "tw-animate-css";
 *   @import "@mkbabb/glass-ui/styles";        (token cascade + SFC scoped CSS)
 *   @import "@mkbabb/glass-ui/styles/fonts";  (OFL woff2 corpus, loaded once)
 *   (then add your project-specific token overrides locally)
 *
 * The single `@mkbabb/glass-ui/styles` import resolves the complete
 * stylesheet: this @import cascade PLUS the per-component `<style scoped>`
 * payload (Aurora grid layering, Progress/Slider/Toast/… scoped rules).
 * The build folds the SFC bundle (`dist/glass-ui.css`) into the dist copy of
 * this file (vite.config.ts `publishStyleAssets`), so a consumer never needs
 * a second `@import "@mkbabb/glass-ui/styles.css"` line. The `./styles.css`
 * export stays reachable as a transparent SFC-only entry (NOT a back-compat
 * alias) for a cascade-free consumer.
 */

/*
 * FONT PAYLOAD SPLIT. The payload-bearing @font-face faces
 * (Plus Jakarta Sans + Fira Code woff2, base64-inlined at publish into
 * ~99 KB gzipped) are NOT imported here — they live in `fonts.css`,
 * reachable via the `@mkbabb/glass-ui/styles/fonts` export. This keeps the
 * critical first-paint `./styles` entry free of the font binary. The
 * calibrated `local()` fallback faces (with Capsize metric overrides) DO
 * stay on this critical path inside typography.css — they paint during the
 * `font-display: optional`/`swap` window with zero CLS, so the deferred
 * real-face import never causes a layout shift.
 *
 * NOTE: Font @import url(...) lines are NOT issued from here (and never
 * were) — doing so would put them after @import "tailwindcss" in the
 * consumer's output, which violates the CSS spec (and some bundlers then
 * drop them). The split above is by separate export subpath, not @import.
 */

/*
 * Cascade order — load order is load-bearing. Each layer references the one
 * above it via CSS custom properties or selector cascade; reordering breaks
 * fallbacks.
 *
 * Each idiom has a localized home complementing the load order below: @theme aliases
 * live in theme.css, @utility recipes in their cohesion-domain file, the
 * cohesion-aware @import-partial carve rule, and the var-in-arbitrary syntax.
 * tokens.css / glass.css / utilities.css are thin @import ROOTS over cohesive
 * tokens/* · glass/* · utilities/* partials (each < 500 lines, in cascade order
 * using the dock.css precedent). The carve is
 * cascade-isomorphic: the partials @import in the recorded cascade order so this
 * load order is preserved bit-for-bit.
 *
 *   1. tokens.css            — thin @import root over tokens/{scheme-motion,
 *                              color-radius,shadow,glass,offsets-sizing,
 *                              scale-paper,light-dark,dark-arm,property-regs}.css.
 *                              CSS custom properties (color, easing, glass,
 *                              paper, shadow, surface-tint rungs). Source-of-
 *                              record for every visual axis.
 *   2. typography.css        — golden-ratio scale (√φ); semantic type classes.
 *                              Pure values, no token consumption.
 *   3. theme.css             — @theme block (Tailwind aliases). Reads tokens
 *                              from (1) so MUST come after them; defines the
 *                              `dark` variant selector consumed by the cascade.
 *   4. glass.css             — thin @import root over glass/{material,ladder,
 *                              surfaces,progress-rail,squircle}.css.
 *                              .glass-{wash,quiet,resting,floating,overlay}
 *                              5-rung ladder + .glass-card / -pill / -btn.
 *                              Consumes tokens (1) + theme aliases (3).
 *  4a. track-well.css       — the ONE shared groove register (`.track-well`).
 *                              A cross-component SHAPE (position/overflow/pill
 *                              radius + the top-only recess ink), NOT a material:
 *                              it declares no backdrop-filter, which is why the
 *                              `glass-` prefix left with it when the register
 *                              moved up out of glass/ (BK #86+#88, C-1).
 *  4b. glass-specular-track.css — the pointer-anchored moving specular rung.
 *                              A `.glass-specular-track` opt-in paints
 *                              a masked radial catch-light tracking the pointer
 *                              (@property-animated, reduced-motion-static, var()
 *                              fallback). Loads after glass.css so it composes
 *                              over the glass tiers.
 *   5. paper.css             — paper underpaint + grain overlay utilities.
 *                              Pairs with (4) for paper-on-glass compositions.
 *   6. components/dock/styles/index.css — the dock CORE: the `@property --dock-morph-t`
 *                              registration, the shared cross-control four-state
 *                              comma-groups, and the `@import`s of the cohesive
 *                              `dock/*.css` partials (shell · morph · density ·
 *                              layers · layer-group · overflow —
 *                              single-axis partials of the dock cascade,
 *                              each < 500 lines, all in the SAME @layer components
 *                              so the cascade is isomorphic). Component utility
 *                              layer; consumes (1) + (3).
 *  6b. components/dock/styles/controls.css — the dock CONTROL families
 *                              dock.css: .dock-icon-button,
 *                              .dark-mode-toggle-button, .dock-tab-button + tiers,
 *                              .dock-select-trigger / .dock-dropdown-trigger, and
 *                              the coarse-pointer touch floor. Same @layer
 *                              components; MUST load directly after dock.css so
 *                              the shared :where()/comma-group contract in (6)
 *                              cascades into these control rules.
 *   7. components/card/styles.css — card and shared card-surface recipes.
 *                              Component utility layer.
 *  7a. components/_shared/feedback/feedback-tone.css — the shared tinted-glass tone register:
 *                              `.feedback-tone` +
 *                              `.feedback-tone-{success,warning,info,destructive}`
 *                              tint a glass rung a bounded % toward a house tone
 *                              token on the EXISTING color-mix(in oklab, …) seam.
 *                              ~~Toast / Alert consume it.~~ Toast composes `.feedback-tone`,
 *                              the tinted PLATE, and is its ONE shipped consumer; Alert
 *                              composes only the four `.feedback-tone-<name>` `--tone`
 *                              registers and spends the tone on the glyph and the ink
 *                              [2026-08-08 · BK #33: R-3 ruled neutral glass + status ink
 *                              — the tinted Alert plate is not built]. Loads after
 *                              cards.css (it reads the same `--glass-plate-*` rung tokens
 *                              cards.css/the ladder mint — now only as the no-rung
 *                              fallback; the live mix base is `--glass-veil`).
 *  7b. components/_shared/feedback/dot-ring.css — the shared work-in-flight register:
 *                              `.glass-dot-ring` + `.glass-dot-ring-bead`, seven beads
 *                              whose unequal sizes rotate at conserved total area
 *                              (BK #28 / EXEMPLARS-CODEX §B3). InfiniteScroll and
 *                              EasingPicker consume it. Loads beside feedback-tone.css
 *                              — same `_shared/feedback` register, same layer, and it
 *                              reads only the spring/duration token families.
 *   8. floating-panel.css    — retired: the
 *                              `.floating-panel` fixed-overlay recipe had ZERO
 *                              consumers; ~~the still-live `.dropdown-menu-content`
 *                              font/inner-pad rules live in menu.css.~~
 *                              [2026-08-09 · BK #66 CLOSE · RT-65-C] the class does
 *                              not exist anywhere in `src` and has not since #89
 *                              W-OVERLAY folded the family's interior into
 *                              `glass/overlay-plate.css` under ONE spelling.
 *                              Detector: `grep -rn 'dropdown-menu-content' src/`
 *                              → four hits, every one a comment. The menu family
 *                              is `components/menu/` and its rows are `.menu__*`.
 *   9. transitions.css       — Vue <Transition> classes (fade, tab-fade,
 *                              pane-swap, metric-swap, dock-in).
 *                              Retired unused fade-slide/pop/
 *                              dialog-scale/dropdown; overlay/menu
 *                              enters ride the .glass-reveal data-reveal register.
 *  10. animations.css        — @keyframes for components consumed via
 *                              `animation:` properties in (9) and component
 *                              <style> blocks. Includes the native top-layer
 *                              `@starting-style` entry/exit grammar.
 *  10a. scroll-driven.css    — native scroll-driven recipes (.scroll-progress
 *                              + [data-scroll-reveal]); the `@supports`-gated
 *                              primary over the JS-composable fallback.
 *  10a'. scroll-choreography.css — the scroll-choreography register
 *                              (.scroll-build page-build / .scroll-cascade
 *                              section-cascade + the native .smooth-scroll
 *                              opt-in) on the native
 *                              scroll()/view()/timeline-scope substrate; NO
 *                              Lenis/GSAP dependency.
 *  10a''. scroll-chrome.css  — the scroll-driven floating-
 *                              CHROME collapse recipe (.scroll-chrome reads
 *                              --chrome-collapse-t for the compositor shrink/
 *                              quiet/shadow-lift; PERSISTENT-by-default, crisp
 *                              blur, never-invisible quiet, PRM-discrete). The
 *                              useScrollChrome JS machine owns the snap + ramp.
 *  10b. view-transition.css  — the `.gl-list-item` View-Transitions group
 *                              recipe + `--vt-*` axes (the
 *                              `useViewTransition` substrate's CSS half).
 *  11. utilities.css         — thin @import root over utilities/{animate,base,
 *                              components,btn}.css. focus-ring,
 *                              shared focus/press recipes, rainbow-vivid +
 *                              rainbow-pastel. Consumes earlier animations +
 *                              tokens.
 *  11a. components/_shared/menu/menu.css — the glass MENU-ROW + MENU-SECTION
 *                              register. AFTER utilities.css so `.glass-menu-row`'s
 *                              `@layer components` hover/highlight rules source-
 *                              order-win over `.interactive-item:hover` (same layer
 *                              + specificity) — the cascade-trap-safe placement.
 *  15. components/tabs/styles/* — SegmentedTabs overflow/indicator grammar.
 *  16. (vacated) — `.glass-control-edge` left `components/_shared/field/
 *                             field-surfaces.css` for glass/control-edge.css at BK
 *                             #82 (six consumers across three families), and the
 *                             portalled list surfaces that used to share that file
 *                             left for glass/overlay-plate.css at #81. The file is
 *                             DELETED; both registers are @import-ed from glass.css.
 *  17. components/sheet/styles.css — precompiled side-sheet positioning (the
 *                             `[data-slot="sheet-content"][data-side]` position/inset/
 *                             size rules), the DETENT geometry (a rung is a size, not a
 *                             translate), the grip, the scroll region and its per-edge
 *                             graded material: geometry ships regardless of consumer
 *                             JIT reach.
 *  17b. components/dialog/styles.css — THE ONE DIALOG LANE: the centred plate's room,
 *                             proportion, ✕ and rebuff, every space value a named rung
 *                             so tokens/sizing.css §1.1 transposes the whole plate.
 *  17c. components/slider/styles.css — THE ONE SLIDER LANE: the scrubber's size axis,
 *                             coarse floor, approach affordance, weight-train and the
 *                             loupe. UNLAYERED, so it outranks the `@layer components`
 *                             track-well and liquid-fill registers it composes.
 *
 *  18. accessibility.css     — terminal reduced-transparency/contrast/motion,
 *                              forced-colors, and coarse-input adaptations.
 *
 * Per-package component CSS lives at (12)-(17) (loaded after utilities so
 * component-local recipes can override). Accessibility then replaces the
 * completed paint as one terminal product mode.
 */
@import "./tokens/index.css";
@import "./typography/index.css";
@import "./theme.css";
@import "./glass.css";
@import "./surface/index.css";
@import "../components/dark-mode-toggle/dark-mode-toggle.css";
@import "../components/dock/index.css";
@import "../components/card/styles.css";
@import "../components/_shared/feedback/feedback-tone.css";
@import "../components/_shared/feedback/dot-ring.css";
@import "./motion/index.css";
@import "./scroll/index.css";
/* Component-owned real-box contraction for <CardHeader shrink>, and the scroll
   owner + edge feather it requires. */
@import "../components/card/scroll.css";
@import "./scroll-chrome.css";
@import "./view-transition.css";
@import "./utilities/index.css";
/* The glass menu-row + menu-section register. Imported after
   utilities.css (not the alternate floating/transitions band) so the
   `.glass-menu-row` `@layer components` hover/highlight rules source-order-WIN
   over `.interactive-item:hover` (utilities/base.css, same layer + specificity) —
   the cascade-trap-safe placement, mirroring glass/surface-axis.css's "import
   AFTER ladder.css" discipline.
   THE PRICE OF WINNING: `transition` is a shorthand, so whichever of the two files
   wins also RESETS the property list. menu.css therefore carries the coherent leg set
   (light + lift + scale) rather than the lift alone — see its own §transition note.
   A leg added to `.interactive-item` and not to `.glass-menu-row` does not paint on a
   menu row. */
@import "../components/_shared/menu/menu.css";
@import "../components/button/styles.css";
@import "../components/configurator/styles.css";
/* hover-popover.css deleted: <HoverPopover> folded onto the
   sealed <Popover trigger="hover"> union; its content rides the shared
   glass-floating + glass-reveal recipe, so the bespoke .hover-popover-panel
   substrate is dead. (clean break, no alias.) */
@import "../components/tabs/styles/segmented.css";
/* The SegmentedTabs additive decoration tail (the .glass-drag-lift
   pull affordance), a partial held under
   the 500-line bound; imported immediately after it
   (~~unlayered~~ [2026-09-22 · BK register wave 10-1 — `@layer components`], unique
   selectors, source-order-after — byte-isomorphic). */
@import "../components/tabs/styles/drag.css";
/* The side sheet's structural positioning + per-edge graded material, precompiled: a
   [data-slot="sheet-content"][data-side] rule so the geometry ships regardless of a
   consumer's Tailwind content-scan reach, replacing dead CVA geometry utilities.
   `:where()` wrapping lets a consumer sizing utility still win. */
@import "../components/sheet/styles.css";
/* THE ONE DIALOG LANE — the centred plate's room, proportion, ✕ and rebuff. */
@import "../components/dialog/styles.css";
/* THE ONE SLIDER LANE — the scrubber's geometry, affordance, weight-train and loupe.
   UNLAYERED on purpose: it composes the `@layer components` well and fill registers
   and must outrank them without an `!important`. */
@import "../components/slider/styles.css";
/* The static numeric-readout family. */
@import "../components/metric/styles.css";
/* The finite notation ribbon: warm folio material plus SVG glyph draw-in.
   Its visual recipe stays with the component while this import fixes its
   cascade position after the base material/utility registers. */
@import "../components/music-staff/styles.css";
/* The thin, radius-following masked scroll-progress band. */
@import "../components/scroll-progress-rim/styles.css";
/* THE WINDOWED-SEQUENCE SUBSTRATE — the stage's room, the authored page turn, the
   capture/settle block and the optional reveal sheet. Optional, tokens-first and
   identity-free: every identity value belongs in a consumer's overlay over these
   data-attributes. */
@import "../components/deck/styles/index.css";
/* The carousel register over that substrate: the ONE gutter token and the FIRED
   half of the member projection's two-clock split. Loads after the substrate it
   composes. */
@import "../components/carousel/styles.css";

/* Accessibility is a terminal product mode, not a mid-cascade patch. This one
   import owns reduced transparency/contrast/motion, forced colors, and coarse
   target adaptation after every material and component recipe. */
@import "./accessibility.css";

/* Ensure Tailwind scans glass-ui's compiled component templates for the utility
   classes they emit (CVA variant classes like text-destructive-foreground,
   layout utilities like h-full/shrink-0).

   The source directive points at `../*.js`, NOT the components-mirror glob
   `../components`. That glob resolves correctly in glass-ui's OWN build
   (`src/styles/index.css` → `src/components` carries the real `.vue` source), but the
   SHIPPED dist copy of this file (`dist/styles/index.css`) resolves `../components` to
   `dist/components/` — a
   directory that carries ONLY `.d.ts` mirror files (zero `.js`, zero `.vue`). The
   compiled render-functions live FLAT at `dist/*.js`. So a consumer that
   re-imports a `@source "../components"` line has Tailwind scan an empty dir and glass-ui's own
   arbitrary utilities silently die.

   `../*.js` reaches the compiled render-functions PRECISELY in the SHIPPED context:
   in dist it is `dist/*.js` (the 150+ flat compiled chunks that carry glass-ui's
   utility class strings — the surface the dead `../components` mirror NEVER held).
   In glass-ui's OWN source build it is `src/*.js` (empty — glass-ui's own components
   compile their CSS through vite, not this `@source`), so the directive is a no-op
   in the own-build and never scans the `src/` shader/`.ts` tree (a bare `../` glob
   tripped Tailwind's dev candidate-extractor on the shader template strings —
   `Missing opening (`). This directive is a BACKSTOP for a consumer that imports
   this exact cascade file — the PRIMARY self-emission path is
   `vite.style-assets.ts emitComponentUtilities`, which ships glass-ui's
   component-utility RULES build-independently into `dist/styles/components.css`.
   Fully-arbitrary BRACKET utilities (`[max-height:…]`, `[--slider-track-height:…]`)
   are rejected by that path's `classish` token filter AND are not reliably reachable
   by a JIT scan, so every STRUCTURAL bracket utility (geometry/bounds/sizing) is
   pre-compiled into shipped CSS instead — never load-bearing on any consumer's
   content-scan reach. */
@source "../*.js";
